dex.text: Stands on the fell looking as if it has been asked a difficult question and is weighing up the answer. Its thick fleece is built for weather that would send a lesser sheep home.
dex.fact: Herdwick sheep are a Lake District breed, and Beatrix Potter was one of their best-known breeders.

dex.text: Has been on the fells longer than most of the walls and is entirely unbothered by the rain. Looks like a grey boulder that has decided to go for a wander.
dex.fact: Herdwick lambs are born almost black and turn grey as they grow older, so a flock is a patchwork of dark and pale.
